question: Oda Sensei!! Hello!! Out of the blue, but please give my Axolotl (unknown gender) a name!! Please!!
answer: Oh a Whooper Looper, huh? It was popular back then. Those cute Mexican salamanders. In general, people call them "Axolotl"(pronounced "Ahoro-toru"). How's this? "AhoAho Ahonosuke"(DumbDumb Dumbbunny). Please be nice to it.
name: GwaaaaaaaaWoaaaaaah
